fr.viewOnly: Only the production manager or the Owner changes this.

noAccess.title: Your role may not see the floor rules
noAccess.body: Your role does not include “production.settings.view”. Ask an administrator if you need this page.

noSites.title: No site to show
noSites.body: Your role reaches no site of this company.

status.station: Floor records name the station only, never the worker.
status.worker: Floor records name the signed-in worker, on the legal basis recorded here.
status.waiting_one: {count} worker has not acknowledged the notice: no floor record names them until they do.
status.waiting_other: {count} workers have not acknowledged the notice: no floor record names them until they do.
status.noBasis: Floor records would name workers, but no legal basis is on record: record it, or name the station only, before real floor work starts.
status.noBasisDefault: This site has no floor rules yet and names workers by default, with no legal basis on record: record it, or name the station only, before real floor work starts.

monitor.title: Who floor records name
monitor.intro: Scans, cut logs and floor stock moves record who did the work, or only where. A change applies from now on; records already made keep what they recorded.

WORKER.title: Name the signed-in worker
WORKER.body: Each floor record names the worker signed in on the tablet (and the station). Needs a legal basis on record, and each worker’s acknowledgement of the notice.

STATION.title: Name the station only
STATION.body: Floor records name the station, never a person. Traceability stays per station, work order and bundle.

basis.title: Legal basis for naming workers
basis.UNION_AGREEMENT: An agreement with the union representatives (RSU or RSA)
basis.NOT_REQUIRED: Counsel’s written opinion that neither is needed
basis.referenceHint: The agreement’s or the authorisation’s number and date, or the opinion’s author and date. The document itself belongs in the files.
basis.kept: The legal basis stays on record; it is never removed.

reason.label: Why floor records will name workers from now on
reason.hint: Kept in the audit log with the change.

impact.title: What this change reaches
impact.narrow: From now on scans and cut logs at this site name the station only, never the worker.
impact.widen: From now on scans and cut logs at this site name the signed-in worker.
impact.devices_one: {count} floor tablet has no station: give it one (Admin › Devices & printers), or it records nothing.
impact.devices_other: {count} floor tablets have no station: give each one a station (Admin › Devices & printers), or they record nothing.
impact.notAcknowledged_one: {count} of {active} active workers has not acknowledged the notice: no record names them until they do (L. 300/1970 art. 4 c.3; GDPR art. 13).
impact.notAcknowledged_other: {count} of {active} active workers have not acknowledged the notice: no record names them until they do (L. 300/1970 art. 4 c.3; GDPR art. 13).
impact.openOrders_one: {count} open work order goes on that way.
impact.openOrders_other: {count} open work orders go on that way.
impact.keep: Records already made keep what they recorded: scans and cut logs are never changed.

held.basis: Give the legal basis and its reference first.
held.reference: Give the reference of the legal basis.
held.reason: Say why floor records will name workers from now on.

save.default: Not set yet: the site follows the default.

confirm.title: Record stations only?
confirm.body: From now on floor records name the station only. Records already made keep their names.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.sentence: Naming workers records more about people: type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.wrong: That code was not accepted. Type the code shown now.
stepUp.locked: Too many codes tried. Wait a few minutes.
stepUp.unavailable: The code could not be checked. Try again.

done.widened: Floor records name the signed-in worker from now on.
done.narrowed: Floor records name the station only from now on.
done.basisRecorded: The legal basis is on record.
done.basisReplaced: The legal basis was replaced; the earlier one stays in the audit log.
done.bundle: The standard bundle size is saved.
done.unchanged: Nothing changed: the rules were already so.
done.checks: The floor rules are saved: they apply from the next scan.
done.full_one: {count} reason added to the floor lists.
done.full_other: {count} reasons added to the floor lists.

elsewhere.title: Changed by someone else meanwhile
elsewhere.body: Reload to see the floor rules as they are now; what you typed is replaced.

problem.read: The server didn’t answer as expected. Try again.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: The floor rules changed meanwhile: reload them and apply again.
problem.invalid: Something was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this at this site.
problem.gone: This site no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Try again.

law.label: The law behind this switch
law.title: Statuto dei Lavoratori, L. 300/1970 art. 4 c.1
law.body: Tools that could also monitor workers may be used only for organisational, production, safety or asset-protection needs, after an agreement with the union representatives or the labour inspectorate’s authorisation; workers are told beforehand how their data is used (art. 4 c.3; GDPR art. 13).
law.none: No legal basis on record at this site.

notice.title: Worker notice
notice.counts: {acknowledged} of {active} active workers acknowledged the notice in force.
notice.noWorkers: No active worker at this site yet.
notice.waiting_one: {count} cannot be named by a floor record until they acknowledge it.
notice.waiting_other: {count} cannot be named by a floor record until they acknowledge it.
notice.countsOnly: Counts only: this page never names a worker.
notice.toPrivacy: The notice’s text and versions: Admin › Privacy & notices

bundle.title: Standard bundle size
bundle.intro: Garments per bundle when the cutter names no size.
bundle.range: Use a whole number from 1 to 500.
bundle.same: This is the size already saved.
bundle.mtm: A made-to-measure garment is always one per bundle.

noAccess.title: Your role may not read the reason codes
noAccess.body: Reading them needs “production.scan”, which the production manager and the operators hold.

checks.title: Floor rules per site
checks.intro: What a tablet checks when a scan is reported at this site. A change applies from the next scan; scans already taken keep what they recorded.
checks.introDefault: This site has no floor rules yet and follows the defaults. A change applies from the next scan.

FREE.label: Relaxed
FREE.body: Operations may be reported in any order; a skipped one is not mentioned.

WARN.label: Warn
WARN.body: A skipped operation is shown on the tablet; the scan still counts.

STRICT.label: Strict
STRICT.body: A required operation skipped stops the scan until the team leader lets it through.

FREE.label: Off
FREE.body: More pieces than the operation before passed is not checked.

WARN.label: Warn
WARN.body: More pieces than the operation before passed is shown; the scan still counts.

STRICT.label: Strict
STRICT.body: More pieces than the operation before passed stops the scan until the team leader lets it through.

scrap.title: Scrap approval
scrap.toggle: Scrap above a limit waits for the team leader
scrap.onHint_one: More than {count} piece of scrap in one scan waits for the team leader's approval before it posts; the scan counts at once.
scrap.onHint_other: More than {count} pieces of scrap in one scan wait for the team leader's approval before they post; the scan counts at once.
scrap.offHint: Scrap posts at once, whatever the quantity.
scrap.noValue: A limit by value (cost) is not kept yet: the limit is in pieces.

checks.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log with the change.
checks.limitRange: Use a whole number of pieces from 1 to 500, or switch the limit off.

read.limit_one: Scrap above {count} piece in one scan waits for the team leader.
read.limit_other: Scrap above {count} pieces in one scan waits for the team leader.

same.title: The same at every site, for now
same.undo: Undo on the tablet: {seconds} seconds after a report, or until the next scan.
same.idle: Sign-out after {minutes} minutes without use (the tablets' settings of this site).
same.clock: A tablet clock off by more than {minutes} minutes is shown; beyond {hours} hours it is flagged on the record.
same.offlineNone: Offline: a tablet keeps every action until the network is back; receipts, inspections, releases and garment labels need the network. No limit in hours or actions yet.
same.offline: Offline: at most {hours} hours or {actions} actions wait on a tablet.
same.where: Idle sign-out is changed with the site's tablets (Admin › Devices & printers); the other rules come per site with a later version.

coupons.title: Bundle codes
coupons.intro: How operators scan a bundle at each operation.

ONE_CODE.title: One bundle code
ONE_CODE.body: The bundle's ticket is scanned at every operation; the operation comes from the station.

COUPON_PER_OPERATION.title: A coupon per operation
COUPON_PER_OPERATION.body: Each operation has its own coupon on the ticket; scanning it reports that operation. Coupons are printed for open work orders.

coupons.stuckHint: Working hours with no scan ({min}–{max}); a stuck bundle is listed on Floor now and Bundles.
coupons.toCoupons: From now on, bundles of open work orders get coupons when they are printed; tickets already on the floor keep working.
coupons.toOne: From now on, only the bundle's ticket is scanned; coupons already printed are no longer needed.
coupons.stuckRange: Use a whole number of working hours from 1 to 720.

read.stuck_one: A bundle with no scan for {count} working hour is stuck.
read.stuck_other: A bundle with no scan for {count} working hours is stuck.

full.complete: Every floor list has its full set of reasons.
full.held: Only who keeps the reason lists adds them (reasons.manage at every company and site).
full.title_one: The full floor lists: {count} reason not added yet
full.title_other: The full floor lists: {count} reasons not added yet

refusal.KIND_FIXED: A code keeps its kind: make a new code of the other kind and set this one inactive.
refusal.BOOKED_BY_CALLS: A help-call type books its waiting to this code: change that type's routing first.
refusal.CODE_NOT_LISTED: This is not an active code of the help-call reasons: add it in Reason codes first.
refusal.TEAM_NOT_ACTIVE: This team is archived or works at another site: pick an active team of the site, or the team leaders.
refusal.WAITING_CODE: The waiting books to an active off-standard code of the company.

cells.failed: The codes could not be read
cells.allOff: The selected rows are inactive already.
cells.allOn: The selected rows are active already.
cells.elsewhere: Someone else changed these codes. Reload to see them as they are now.

off.title: Off-standard codes
off.intro: Codes for time not on standard work (waiting, cleaning, training…), each with its pay rule. Operators pick them on the tablet when no bundle runs; a help call's waiting books to one.

noAccess.title: Your role may not see the off-standard codes

ccnl.title: Pay rules not checked against your CCNL
ccnl.body: Average earnings, base hourly or unpaid is your choice per code: confirm each with your labour consultant before pay uses it.

readOnly.title: You can look, not change
readOnly.body: Keeping the codes needs “production.offstandard.codes” (the production manager).

kindHint.OFF_STANDARD: Time lost from standard work (waiting, machine down).
kindHint.INDIRECT: Work that is not on a bundle (training, cleaning, meetings).

payHint.AVERAGE: Paid as the worker's average earnings (CCNL to confirm).
payHint.BASE: Paid at the base hourly rate (CCNL to confirm).

empty.title: No off-standard code yet
empty.body: Add the first one: waiting for material, cleaning, training…

new.title: New off-standard code
new.intro: A code is set inactive, never deleted; its kind never changes.
new.approvalHint: On: the team leader approves the time before pay uses it.
new.codeShape: Use 2 to 40 upper-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

route.title: Help-call routing
route.intro: Each type of help call goes to a group of the site: their bells and tablets hear it at once. The waiting can book to an off-standard code, so it never counts against the worker.
route.hint: Escalation minutes are kept now; the timed escalation comes with a later version.

noAccess.title: Your role may not see the help-call routing

readOnly.title: You can look, not change
readOnly.body: Keeping the routing needs “production.calls.manage” (the production manager).

route.noPeople: Picking a team needs people.view: the group is shown as it is.
route.kindFixed: A type keeps its kind: the calls already sent were routed by it.
route.escalateRange: Escalate after 1 to 240 whole minutes, or leave it empty for never.

empty.title: No help-call type at this site
empty.body: Add the first one: each is a code of the help-call reasons, sent to a group.

held.noCodes: Every help-call reason is a type here already: add a reason in Reason codes first.

new.title: New help-call type
new.intro: A type is a code of the help-call reasons (its words, icon and colour on the tablet). Its kind never changes.
new.codeHint: The reasons not yet a type at this site.
new.kindHint: Machine, material, quality, supervisor, maintenance or other: it decides how the call is shown and counted.
new.groupHint: A team of the site, or the site's team leaders.
